verses.text: አውስጢድ በሚባል ሀገር ስሙ ኢዮብ የተባለ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ ያም ሰው ቅን፥ ንጹሕና ጻድቅ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ፥ ከክፉ ሥራም ሁሉ የራቀ ነበር።
ሰባትም ወንዶች፥ ሦስትም ሴቶች ልጆች ነበሩት።
ከብቶቹም፦ ሰባት ሺህ በጎች፥ ሦስት ሺህ ግመሎች፥ አምስት መቶም ጥማድ በሬ፥ አምስት መቶም እንስት አህዮች ነበሩ፤ እጅግ ብዙም አገልጋዮች ነበሩት፤ ሥራውም በምድር ላይ ታላቅ ነበረ፤ ያም ሰው በምሥራቅ ካሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ ገናና ነበረ።
ወንዶች ልጆቹም ሄደው በየተራ በእያንዳንዳቸው ቤት ግብዣ ያደርጉ ነበር፤ ሦስቱ እኅቶቻቸውንም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይወስዱአቸው ነበር፤ ከእነርሱም ጋር ይበሉና ይጠጡ ነበር።
የግብዣውም ቀኖች በተፈጸሙ ጊዜ ኢዮብ ይልክና ይቀድሳቸው ነበር፤ በማለዳም ገሥግሦ፦ ስለ ልጆቹ በቍጥራቸው መሥዋዕት ያቀርብ ነበር፤ አንድ ወይፈን ስለ ነፍሳቸው የኀጢአት መሥዋዕት ያቀርብ ነበር፤ ኢዮብ፥ “ምናልባት ልጆቼ በልባቸው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ክፉ ነገር ያስቡ ይሆናል” ይል ነበርና።
ከዕለታት አንድ ቀንም እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የእግዚአብሔር መላእክት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመቆም መጡ፤ ሰይጣንም ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ጋር መጣ።
እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን፥ “ከወዴት መጣህ?” አለው። ሰይጣንም፥ “ምድርን ሁሉ ዞርሁአት፥ ከሰማይ በታችም ተመላለስሁና መጣሁ።” ብሎ ለእግዚአብሔር መለሰ።
እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን አለው፥ “በባሪያዬ በኢዮብ ላይ የምታስበው ነገር እንዳይኖር ተጠንቀቅ! በምድር ላይ እንደ እርሱ ቅን፥ ንጹሕና ጻድቅ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ፥ ከክፉ ሥራም ሁሉ የራቀ ሰው የለምና።”
ሰይጣንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰ፥ “በውኑ ኢዮብ እግዚአብሔርን የሚያመልከው በከንቱ ነውን?
አንተ ቤቱን በውስጥም በውጭም፥ በዙሪያው ያለውንም ሁሉ አልሞላህለትምን? የእጁንም ሥራ ባርከህለታል፥ ከብቱንም በምድር ላይ አብዝተህለታል።
"But your hand shall be upon all that he possesses; truly, in your presence, it shall be brought low."
And the Lord said unto Satan, "Behold, all that he hath is in your hand; however, do not lay a hand upon him." And Satan went forth from the presence of the Lord.

sections.title: The possessions of Job were as if they had perished, and his children as if they had died.

verses.text: And it came to pass on a certain day, that the sons and daughters of Job were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house.
And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, "The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them;
And the Sabeans fell upon them and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee."

While he was yet speaking, there came also another messenger, and said, "The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee."

While he was yet speaking, there came another and said, "The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away; yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee."
While he was yet speaking, there came another and said, "Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house;
And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee."
Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped;
And said, "Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the Lord gave, and the Lord hath taken away; blessed be the name of the Lord."
In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.
And it came to pass on a certain day, that the angels of the Lord came to present themselves before the Lord, and Satan also came among them to present himself before the Lord.
And the Lord said unto Satan, “Whence comest thou?” And Satan answered the Lord, and said, “From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

And the Lord said unto Satan, “Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? And still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movest me against him, to destroy him without cause.”
And Satan answered the Lord, and said, “Doth Job fear God for nought?
Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? Thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.”
But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.”
And the Lord said unto Satan, “Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand.” So Satan went forth from the presence of the Lord.
And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:

And his wife said unto him, “Dost thou still retain thine integrity? Curse God, and die.” But he said unto her, “Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this did not Job sin with his lips.
Then said Job unto her, “Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

sections.title: And his friends came to visit Job.

verses.text: And three of Job's friends heard of all this evil that had come upon him; and they came, each from his own country: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite. They made an appointment together to come and mourn with him and to comfort him.
And when they saw him from afar, they did not recognize him; and they lifted their voices and wept aloud; and each one tore his robe and sprinkled dust on his head toward heaven.
And they sat with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.

sections.title: Job cursed the day of his birth.

verses.text: ከዚያም በኋላ ኢዮብ አፉን ከፈተ፥ የተወለደባትንም ቀን ረገመ።
እንዲህም አለ፦
“ያች የተወለድሁባት ቀን ትጥፋ፥
ያች ቀን ጨለማ ትሁን፤
ጨለማና የሞት ጥላ ያግኙአት፤
ያች ቀንም የተረገመች ትሁን።
ለዚያም ሌሊት ጭንቅ ይሁን፥
ነገር ግን ሌዋታንን ለመግደል የተዘጋጀ
የዚያ ሌሊት ኮከቦች ይጨልሙ፤
የእናቴን ማኅፀን ደጅ አልዘጋምና፥
በማኅፀን ሳለሁ ስለ ምን አልሞትሁም?
ጕልበቶች ስለ ምን ደገፉኝ?
አሁንም ተኝቼ ዝም ባልሁ ነበር፤
በሰይፋቸው ከከበሩ
ወይም ወርቅን ካበዙ፥
ወይም ከእናቱ ማኅፀን እንደ ወጣ ጭንጋፍ፥
ኃጥኣን በዚያ በቍጣው መቅሠፍት ይቃጠላሉ፤
በዚያም የጥንት ዘመን ሰዎች በአንድነት፥
ታናሹና ታላቁ በዚያ አሉ፤
በመራራነት ላሉት ብርሃን፥
Better is he who does not covet the wealth of the oppressed,
For in the time of their finding, joy shall be unto them,
Death is the rest for man,
For my supplication hath come before my anguish,
The matter that hath troubled me hath come upon me,
I am weary; I have not found rest.
ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ መለሰ፥ እንዲህም አለ፦
“በመከራ ሳለህ ነገር አታብዛ፥ የነገር ብዛት ምን ይጠቅምሃል?
እነሆ፥ አንተ ብዙዎችን ታስተምር ነበር፥
በቃልህ በሽተኞችን ታስነሣ ነበር፥
አሁን ግን ሕማም በአንተ ላይ መጥቶ ዳሰሰህ።
ጥንቱን ፍርሀትህ፥ ተስፋህም፥
እባክህ አስብ፥ ንጹሕ ሆኖ የጠፋ ማን ነው?
እኔ እንዳየሁ፥ ኀጢኣትን የሚያርሱ፥ የሚዘሩአትም
በእግዚአብሔርም ትእዛዝ ይጠፋሉ፥
የአንበሳው ጩኸት፥ የአንበሳዪቱም ድምፅ፥
"He who eats the bread of the poor is forsaken;
However, if you were to speak any truth, let it be known;
When fear falls upon men,
let them take hold of the rock and tremble;
My spirit has passed before my face;
I arose; yet I did not know;
Who can be pure before God?
Behold, even His servants do not trust in Him;
Indeed, we are formed from the same dust;
They do not dwell from dawn until dusk."
They shall be consumed with fire, for they have provoked Me.
"Now, if there is one who would return to you, do not be harsh;
for anger will slay the foolish man;
they have seen the foolish ones beneath their feet;
their children have strayed far from safety;
they shall consume the righteous whom they have gathered together.
Trouble does not arise from the earth;
yet the servants of Amora shall rise high, saying,
'But I, I have been calling upon the Lord,
He is the great thing that cannot be shaken,
and He will send rain upon the earth.'"
He shall exalt the humble,
He shall change the counsel of the wicked,
And He shall uphold the wise in their understanding;
In the day of darkness, He shall find them,
In warfare, they shall perish;
For there is hope for the afflicted;
"But behold, the Lord is a righteous man;
He shall deliver him, and he shall be a refuge for him;
Six times shall He deliver you from evil,
In times of famine, He shall deliver you from death."
He shall be as a giraffe in the wilderness,
Thou shalt have dominion over the wicked and the oppressors;
The beasts of the wilderness shall be in agreement with thee.
At that time, thou shalt know that thy house is in peace;
And thy seed shall be abundant,
In its season, may the harvest be gathered together;
Behold, this is what we have known, and what we have heard is this.
ኢዮብም መለሰ፥ እንዲህም አለ፦
“ከእናንተ አንዱ መቅሠፍቴን ምነው በመዘነ ኖሮ!
ከባሕር አሸዋ ይልቅ ይከብድ ነበርና፤
እነሆ፥ የእግዚአብሔር ፍላጻ በሥጋዬ ላይ ነው፤
በውኑ የሜዳ አህያ ሣር እያለው በከንቱ ይጮኻልን? የሚበላውን ፈልጎ አይደለምን?
ምግብ ያለ ጨው ይበላልን?
ሰውነቴ ማረፍ አልቻለችም፤
ልመናዬ ምነው በደረሰልኝ!
እግዚአብሔርም ያቈስለኝ ዘንድ ጀመረ፥
መቃብሬ በግንቡ የምመላለስበት ከተማዬ ይሁን፥
What is the cause of my affliction?
Is my affliction of stone armor?
Am I not one who has trusted in Him?
His mercy is abundant upon me,
"And my brethren are like a dry river,
Those who honored me have become like them,
As they approach the heat in the time of scorching,
Even so, I have perished, set apart from all,
The paths of the wicked,
In the cities and in the riches, they shall be afraid.
Now, behold, you have come without mercy;
For what reason? Truly, did I ask anything of you?
Or shall you deliver me from the hand of my enemies?
"Teach me, and I will also instruct you;
A true man shall resemble a word of falsehood;
And your speech shall not grant me rest;
You shall be merciless upon the poor;
Even now, I do not see your face;
Even now, take your place; let not iniquity behold you;
For in my dwelling, there is no iniquity.
"Is not the life of man upon the earth a fleeting shadow?"
"Or as a servant who fears his master, so is the plea of the one who seeks."
"Thus, I shall endure the days of vanity."
"In the time of my slumber: When shall I awaken? I say;"
"My flesh is consumed with sorrow and my bones are troubled."
"My life is like a fleeting breath; it has become light."
"Consider that my life is as a vapor."
"The eye that sees me shall see me no more; from henceforth, I shall be unseen."
"As a cloud vanishes and is gone, so shall I be lost."
"And to his house he shall not return again."
Therefore, I have not withheld my mouth;
For I am your guardian,
And I say, "Will my bed comfort me?"
You too are troubled in a dream,
You separate life from my spirit.
Shall I dwell forever?
What is man? That you should exalt him,
As the dawn approaches, you visit him,
Until when shall I be forsaken?
O you who knows the heart of man,
Why do you not forgive my transgression?
The Awakened one replied, saying:
"Until when will you speak this matter?
Will the Lord truly judge us in the end?
Your children are before Him as if they are guilty,
"But you, draw near to the Lord,
if you be pure and righteous,
even if your offering be small,
therefore inquire of the former generation, and examine the fathers in their time with diligence,
we are but yesterday; we know nothing at all;
they will instruct you and tell you."
"In truth, shall a dwelling be established in a land where there is no foundation?"
"Yet while he is still in his flesh, without being consumed,"
"All who seek the Lord shall find their end as such;"
"A house without an inhabitant shall be desolate,"
"Though it be forsaken, it shall not cease to exist;"
"It shall flourish beneath the sun;"
"It shall thrive upon the stone's edge;"
"If the place should be uprooted:"
"Sinners likewise shall be consumed;"
"Behold, the Lord shall not forsake the one who is righteous,"
The mouth of the wicked shall be filled with iniquity,
And their adversaries shall be clothed with shame;
ኢዮብም እንዲህ ሲል መለሰ፦
“በእውነት እንዲህ እንደ ሆነ ዐወቅሁ፤
ከእርሱ ጋር ይከራከር ዘንድ ቢወድድ፥
በልቡ ጠቢብ ነው፥ ኀይለኛም፥ ታላቅም ነው፤
ተራሮችን ይነቅላል፤ አያውቁትምም፤
ምድርን ከሰማይ በታች ከመሠረቷ ያናውጣታል፥
ፀሐይን ያዝዛታል፥ አትወጣምም፤
ሰማያትን ብቻውን ይዘረጋል፥
ድብ የሚባለውን ኮከብና ኦሪዮን የሚባለውን ኮከብ፥

መባው ወደ ሰማይ ቢወጣ፥
እነሆ ተደላድያለሁ በሚልበት ጊዜ ለዘለዓለም ይጠፋል።
እንደ ሕልም ይበርራል፤ እርሱም አይገኝም፤
ዐይን አየችው፤ ነገር ግን ዳግመኛ አታየውም፤
የተዋረዱ ሰዎች ልጆቹን ያጠፋሉ፤
Distress hath filled the bones;
"If thou dost speak wickedness with thy mouth;
Though it may guard thee, it shall not protect thee;
Ultimately, it cannot save itself.
Wealth that is hoarded in vanity shall perish;
The sting of the serpent shall be upon it;
And the wounds of the scorpions,
For that which cannot be preserved, that which cannot be retained, and that which cannot be sustained,
The houses of the poor hath been laid waste;
For there is no keeper for the possessions.
ለሀብቱ ትርፍ የለውም፤
በጠገበ ጊዜ ይጨነቃል፤
“ሆዱን ቢያጠግብ፥
ከሰይፍም ኀይል አያመልጥም፤
ቀስቱም በሥጋው ውስጥ ያልፋል።
ጨለማ ሁሉ ይጠብቀዋል፤
ሰማይ ኀጢኣቱን ይገልጥበታል፤
ጥፋትም ቤቱን ወደ ፍጻሜ ያመጣታል።
ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የኀጢአተኛ ሰው እድል ፋንታው፥
ኢዮብም መለሰ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦
“እኛ አጽናናነው እንዳትሉኝ፥
እናገር ዘንድ ዝም በሉ፤
ሰው የሚዘልፈኝ አይደለም፤
ወደ እኔ ተመልከቱ፥ ተደነቁም፤
እኔ ባሰብሁ ቍጥር እጨነቃለሁ፤
ስለ ምን ኀጢኣተኞች በሕይወት ይኖራሉ?
ዘራቸው በፊታቸው ከእነርሱ ጋር ጸንቶ ይኖራል፤
ቤታቸው በብልፅግና የተሞላ ነው፤ የሚያስፈራቸውም የለም።
በሬዎቻቸው አይመክኑም፤
እነርሱም እንደ በጎች ለዘለዓለም ይጠበቃሉ፤
በገናና መሰንቆ ይዘው ይዘምራሉ፤
ዕድሜያቸውንም በተድላ ይፈጽማሉ፤
እግዚአብሔርንም፦ እንዲህ ይሉታል፦ ከእኛ ዘንድ ራቅ፤
እንገዛለትስ ዘንድ እርሱ ምን ይችላል?
“እነሆ፥ በጎነታቸው በእጃቸው ውስጥ አለች፤
የኃጥኣን መብራት ትጠፋለች፤
በነፋስም ፊት እንደ ገለባ፥
ልጆቹ ሀብቱን አያገኙም።
ዐይኖቹ ልጆቹ ሲወጉ ያያሉ፤
He shall do what is pleasing to him within his house.
Is it not the Lord who teaches ancient wisdom and counsel?
When a man sits down in peace,
his heart is filled with fatness,
while another man does not partake of good things at all.
All lie down together in the dust;
Behold, you are afraid;
And you: Where is the house of the master?
Ask the wayfarers of the road;
The sinner shall keep watch over the evil day.
Who is it that speaks of the way before him?
Yet they shall carry him to the grave;
The friend of the fool shall be brought low;
Why do you toil in vain?
And Temanite Eliphaz answered, and said:
"Indeed, he who teaches understanding and knowledge,
What has God done to you, if you are pure in your work?
Have you been provoked that you should be deceived?
Is your wickedness not great?
You have taken away the covering of your brothers in vain,
You have not given drink to the thirsty,
They say, 'Do not look upon their face, lest you be troubled.'
You have stripped the naked of their garments,
Therefore, I am filled with grief.
And the light has become darkness unto thee,
"Is it not fitting that the one who is exalted should act according to what is right?"
And thou didst say, "What can the mighty one know?"
The cloud that is darkened shall not be seen;
Truly, the righteous have been oppressed,
and before their time they were taken away;
What shall the Lord do for us?
Yet, He has filled their house with good things;
The righteous shall not be forsaken;
Indeed, their wealth has perished,
"Now, even if you are to be struck,
receive the law from your mouth,
if you return, and in the presence of the Lord you humble yourself,
in the world you shall establish a record for yourself.
The God who is able to do all things shall deliver you from your enemies.
At that time, you shall find grace in the sight of the Lord.
And to Him you shall pray, and He shall hear you;
He shall grant you the reward of your righteousness.
If you humble yourself, even if a man says, "Do not trouble me,"
the righteous man shall deliver him."
ኢዮብም መለሰ፥ እንዲህም አለ፦
“ዛሬም ዘለፋዬ ከእጄ እንደ ሆነ ዐወቅሁ።
እርሱን ወዴት እንደማገኘው ምነው ባወቅሁ!
የሠራሁት ቢኖር ይነግረኝ ነበረ፥
የሚሰጠኝንም ፈውስ አውቅ ነበር፥
በኀይሉ ብዛት ቢመጣብኝም እንኳ
እውነትና ቅንነት ከእርሱ ዘንድ ናቸውና።
እነሆ፥ ወደ ፊት እሄዳለሁ፥ እንግዲህም አልኖርም፤
ወደሚሠራበትም ወደ ግራ ብሄድ አልመለከተውም፤
መንገዴን ፈጽሞ ዐወቀ፥
As I have commanded, so will I go forth,
And I have not turned aside from the command;
"Who is it that brings forth judgment?
Therefore, I have lamented concerning him;
Therefore, I have rejoiced before Him;
But the Lord has purified my heart,
Even as darkness approaches me,
“እግዚአብሔር ዘመኖችን ለምን ረሳቸው?
ኃጥኣን የድንበሩን ምልክት አለፉ፤
የድሃአደጎቹን አህያ ይነዳሉ
ደካሞችን ከእውነት መንገድ ያወጣሉ፤
እነሆ፥ በምድረ በዳ እንዳሉ እንደ ሜዳ አህዮች ሆኑ።
“የራሳቸው ያልሆነውን እርሻ ያለ ሰዓቱ ያጭዳሉ።
ብዙዎችን የተራቈቱትንም ያለ ልብስ ያሳድሩአቸዋል።
በካፊያና ከተራሮች በሚወርድ ጠል ይረጥባሉ፤
ድሃአደጉን ልጅ ከጡቱ ይነጥላሉ፤
ችግረኞችን በደሉአቸው፥ ጣሉአቸውም፤
They shall be consumed in the place of torment, in the day of judgment.
They shall be taken away from the city and from their own houses.
"But why, O Lord, have You not spared them?"
Their works shall be revealed, and they shall be cast into darkness.
The eye of the Almighty watches over the humble.
He shall bring down the houses of darkness;
The light of dawn shall be like death to them all;
He shall not pass over the waters before Him;
They shall see Him when they are cast down upon the earth.
After this, He shall remember their iniquity.
ለማትወልደው ለመካኒቱ በጎነትን አላደረገላትም፤
ነገር ግን ረዳት የሌላቸውን በቍጣው አጠፋቸው።
በታመመም ጊዜ መዳንን ተስፋ አያደርግም።
ከፍ ከፍ ባለ ጊዜም ብዙዎችን አስጨነቃቸው።
እንዲህስ ባይሆን ሐሰተኛ ነህ የሚለኝ፥
አውኬናዊውም በልዳዶስ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ፦
“ጥንቱን መፈራት በእርሱ ዘንድ ያለ አይደለምን?
ለሌቦች ዕረፍትን የሚሰጥ እንዳለ የሚመስለው አይኑር።
ጻድቅ ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዴት ንጹሕ ይሆናል?
እነሆ፥ ጨረቃ እንኳ ይሰወራል፤ አያበራምም፤
ይልቁንስ ፈራሽ የሆነ ሰው፥
And Job answered and said:
"Whom dost Thou support? Whom dost Thou love to deliver?
To whom dost Thou show compassion?
And concerning whom dost Thou speak?
The mighty are beneath the waters,
Sheol is before Him, it is the place of the dead,
The heavens are spread out over an empty space,
The waters are poured out within the clouds,
The face of His canopy is obscured,
From the darkness until the dawn breaks forth.
የሰማይ አዕማድ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፥
በኀይሉ ባሕርን ጸጥ ያደርጋል፥
የሲኦል በረኞች ለእርሱ አደሉ።
እነሆ ይህ የመንገዱ ክፍል ነው፤
And Job spoke a parable, saying thus:
"As I have been forsaken, the living God is my witness!
Even though my spirit is still within me,
my breath shall not depart from my lips;
Let my integrity be far from me;
I have not ceased to do righteousness;
My adversaries shall be like the wicked,
"Why should the sinner hope for wealth, when he shall not be satisfied?
Truly, when affliction comes upon me,
shall I find in Him the fullness of His grace?
But I shall instruct you what is in the hand of the Lord;
Behold, all of you,
This is a chance of the sinner from the Lord;
If his children multiply, they shall be for destruction;
And those who remain for him shall die.
He shall scatter silver as dust;
All these shall be taken by the righteous.
His house shall be like a spider's web;
The owner shall lie down, and there shall be none to awaken him;
Sorrow shall find her like a thorn.
The breath that causes destruction has arisen.
Upon him shall come that which he knows not.
In him shall his hand be ensnared.
"Truly, there is a place where silver is brought forth,
And iron is drawn out of the earth;
It shall bring forth darkness and shall be a veil;
By reason of the earth, as a river is divided;
Bread shall come forth from the ground;
Its stone is like the stones of the earth;
Its path the hawk knows not;
The children of the proud have not trodden it;
A man shall lay his hand upon the flint;
From the stone shall come forth a precious thing."
The folly of the foolish shall be made manifest.
"But where shall wisdom be found?"
A foolish man knoweth not his way;
She saith, "In me there is no wisdom."
Concerning her, no one shall give gold in vain.
Do not let her be compared with the gold of Ophir.
Neither shall gold and silver be compared unto her;
The cedar and the hyssop shall not be mentioned in her presence.
The lilies of Ethiopia shall not be esteemed in her sight;
"Then where shall wisdom be found?"
በሰው ሁሉ ዘንድ ተረስታለች፥
ሞትና ሲኦል ወሬዋን በጆሮቻችን ሰማን ብለዋል።
“እግዚአብሔር መንገድዋን አሳመረ፥
እርሱም በሰማይ ያለውን ይመለከታል፥
ለነፋስ ሚዛንን
እነዚህን በፈጠረ ጊዜ እንዲሁ ዐውቆ ቈጠራቸው።
በዚያን ጊዜ አያት፥ ገለጣትም፤
ሰውንም፦ ‘እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ጥበብ ነው፤

sections.title: The Conclusion of the Book of Job

verses.text: And Job spoke a parable, saying:
"The Lord shall keep me as He did in days of old,
when my lamp shone upon my head,
and by His light I walked through darkness;
when I was in my prime,
when the friendship of God was upon my tent;
when the Almighty was yet with me,
and my children were about me;
when my steps were washed with butter,
and the rock poured out rivers of oil for me."
My ear has heard of You, and it is pure.
I shall deliver the needy from the hand of the oppressor.
I am delivered unto death;
I have clothed myself in righteousness;
For the blind, I have given sight;
I was a father to the poor;
I have broken the yoke of the wicked;
I also am as one who is in distress and as one who is in need;
Water shall flow upon my soul;
My glory shall be exalted in me;
“ሰዎች እኔን ይሰሙኛል፥ ያዳምጡኝማል፥
በነገሬ ላይ ደግመው አይናገሩም፤
የተጠማች ምድር ዝናምን ተስፋ እንደምታደርግ፥
በእነርሱ ብስቅ አያምኑም፤
መንገዳቸውን መረመርሁ፤
"But now, in age, let those who are younger than I come to me for counsel;
What is the strength of their hands to me?
Yesterday, they were brought low and in distress from the wilderness;
As they gather, they call upon me and they eat;
"Rise up, you lions, against me;
In the thicket, they roam and in the depths of the earth;
In the midst of the crowd, they cry out;
They are the children of the wicked and of the evil ones;
Even now, I have become their singer and their mocker.
They have cried out against me, and they have turned away from me;
He has lifted up the mouth of the wicked against me;
By His mighty right hand, arise and help me;
Destroy my pursuit;
As one who has fallen, He has dealt with me;
The stone has turned back upon me;
"Even now my soul is troubled within me;
Throughout the night, my bones are shaken with fear;
From the great terror, my heart has become dismayed;
He has overwhelmed me like mud;
I cried out to You, but You did not hear me;
Mercy has been shown to those who have none,
In sorrow, I have been made to endure,
For I know that death seeks to consume me,
I myself was to be delivered, for I was beloved,
I have been forsaken by one who offers no help,
Yet, in the time of guarding good,
My heart has longed, and it has not forsaken me;
I went forth in pursuit, and I was met with that which overwhelms me,
For the night is a wolf, O brother,
My sacrifice has been greatly despised.
ስለዚህ ሕማሜ መሰንቆ፥
"I have made a covenant with mine eyes,
The favor of the Lord is upon me,
Death to the sinner,
Is He not the one who sees my way?
I went with the wicked as it was,
Let us weigh in true balance,
My step has strayed from His path,
I am to be forsaken, and another shall consume him;
My heart has followed another man’s wife,
My wife delights in another man."
Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's wife,
This is a fire that burns in all flesh,
"If a man or a woman servant be found in my possession at the time of their escape,
What shall I do when the Lord has examined me?
Am I not created by Him who formed me in the womb?
"As I have made it so that the dogs do not catch what they chase,
Let my bread be for myself alone,
From his humility, he was as a father to me,
The man who is strong shall not see death when he is cold,
The dogs do not bark at me as it is.
I have trusted that there is much help for me.
My foundation shall be cast down.
For the glory of the Lord God has overwhelmed me;
"And my grave shall be as if it were in the earth,
When my wealth has increased, it brought me joy;
As the sun that shines shall fade away,
My heart has been troubled as if it were in distress;
Before the Most High God, I was in anguish;
In the downfall of my adversary, it brought me joy;
My ear shall hear my supplication.
“ቤተ ሰቦቼ እኔ ስራራላቸው፥
መጻተኛው ግን በሜዳ አያድርም ነበር፥
ታላቅ በደልም በድዬ እንደ ሆነ፥
ከብዙ ሕዝብ የተነሣ በፊታቸው ለመናገር አፍሬ እንደ ሆነ፥
የሚያደምጠኝን ማን በሰጠኝ!
በትከሻዬ ላይ እሸከመው ነበር፥
ከባለ ዕዳዬ የምቀበለው ሳይኖር
“እርሻዬ በእኔ ላይ ጮኻ እንደ ሆነ፥
ፍሬዋን ለብቻዬ ያለ ዋጋ በልቼ እንደ ሆነ፥
በስንዴ ፋንታ እንክርዳድ፥
And Job was righteous in his own eyes before them; therefore those three friends held their peace and did not answer Job.
From the land of Uz, of the family of the Buzite, Elihu the son of Barachel was angry, for he had been righteous in his own eyes before God, and he was angry with Job.
Moreover, they had not been able to give a fitting answer to Job, but instead they were angry with the three friends for their words.
Yet Elihu was more concerned than they, and he waited to give an answer to Job.
And when Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouths of these three men, he was greatly angered.
Then Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, "I am young in days, and you are aged; therefore I held back and did not declare my knowledge to you."
Thus I said, "Days speak, and a multitude of years teaches wisdom."
But there is a spirit in man,
and the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding.
But truly, hear my words;
Behold, let my discourse be heeded;
Likewise, I have prepared my heart;
And you have received wisdom from the Lord God;
But you, in this manner, speak;
"You are afraid, yet you do not turn back;
I have waited in patience, yet I have not spoken."
And Elihu answered and said:
"I have filled my words;
as the pitcher is filled with water, and as the offering is presented, I will pour forth;
a little shall I speak, that I may breathe."
ከሰው የተነሣ አላፍርምና፥
ለሰው ፊት ማድላትን አላውቅም፤

sections.title: And Elihu spoke unto Job as he was angry.

verses.text: “ነገር ግን፥ ኢዮብ ሆይ፥ ቃሌን ስማ፥
እነሆ፥ አፌን ከፍቻለሁ፥
ልቤም ንጹሕ ነገርን ያስባል፥
የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ፈጠረኝ፥
በዚህ ነገር ልትመልስልኝ ትችል እንደ ሆነ ታገሠኝ፥
አንተ እንደ እኔ ከጭቃ የተፈጠርህ ነህ፥
እነሆ፥ ግርማዬ አታስፈራህም፥
ግፍህን ተናግረሃል፥
እኔ ንጹሕ ነኝ፥ አልበደልሁምና፤
እነሆ፥ ምክንያት አግኝቶብኛል፥
I have set my foot upon the ground,
Behold, I am righteous; how dost thou say, "Thou dost not hear my cry"?
Thou dost say, "Why dost Thou not hear my voice?"
The Lord speaks in a dream or in a vision of the night,
when deep sleep falls upon men,
then He opens the understanding of men,
that He may turn man from his iniquity,
and He shall deliver his soul from death;
"Moreover, in the night, He shall speak to him in a dream,
and he shall not be able to eat any food."
The flesh shall remain until it departs,
The body is for death,
Though the angels of death may be thousands,
It shall be kept that it does not perish in death,
The flesh shall be as that of a child, without blemish;
And unto God shall he pray,
At that time, a man shall awaken himself; and he shall say,
"My soul has been preserved that it may not descend to destruction,"
"Behold, He who is able to do all things,
My life shall give thanks within the light."
ኢዮብ ሆይ፥ አድምጥ፥ እኔንም ስማ፤
ነገር ቢኖርህ ተናገር፤
ያለዚያም እኔን ስማ፤

sections.title: Elihu spoke, declaring that he was to be a true messenger of the Lord.

verses.text: ኤልዩስ ደግሞ መለሰ፥ እንዲህም አለ፦
“እናንተ ጥበበኞች፥ ቃሌን ስሙ፤
ጆሮ ቃልን ትለያለችና፥
ፍርድን ለራሳችን እንምረጥ፤
ኢዮብ እንዲህ ብሎአልና፦ እኔ ጻድቅ ነኝ፥
ፍርዴን ሐሰተኛ አደረገብኝ፤
መሣለቅን እንደ ውኃ የሚጠጣት፥
ፈጽሞ ያልበደለ፥
ሰው ከእግዚአብሔር ጕብኝት ሲኖረው
“ሰለዚህ እናንተ አእምሮ ያላቸሁ ሰዎች ስሙኝ፤
To every man, according to his work, shall it be returned to him.
Truly, dost thou act as one who commits violence against the Lord God?
The world that is beneath the heavens,
In Him is the spirit that dwelleth,
Flesh for all flesh shall die in unity,
Yet, take heed; hear this also:
He who pursueth violence, and destroyeth the wicked,
The king, it is said, thou art a transgressor;
Yet He doth not turn away from the face of the honorable.
He hath found vain things, the one who crieth out and the man who cannot hear.
He will examine the works of men,
There is no place for those who commit sin.
For all who see shall not be hidden from the Lord God.
The Lord looks down upon the earth and upon men,
He knows their works,
He will destroy the wicked,
Those who have turned away from the law of God,
And He shall hear the cry of the needy and respond to them,
"He will grant rest to them;
For the oppression of the people."
“ኀያሉ እግዚአብሔርን፦ እንዲህ የሚል አለ፥
እኔ ራሴ አያለሁ፥
በውኑ አንተ ከእኔ ትርቅ ዘንድ፥
የልብ ጥበበኞች እንዲህ ይላሉና፦
ኢዮብ እንደ ጠቢብ በዕውቀት አይናገርም፥
ነገር ግን ኢዮብ ሆይ፥ ተማር።
በኀጢአቶችህ ላይ እንዳትጨምር፥

sections.title: Job, in his affliction, was reproached by Elihu as one who had contended.

verses.text: And Elihu also answered and said:
"What dost thou say when thou art reproved?
What shall I do concerning sin? Thou dost say.
I will answer thee and thy three friends.
Look unto the heavens, and behold;
If thou dost commit sin, what dost thou do against Him?
If thou art righteous, what dost thou give unto Him?
Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art;
Many shall cry out because of the multitude of oppressors;
Yet, in the night, my Creator, the Lord God, shall command our preservation.
እርሱም ከምድር እንስሶች ይልቅ፥
በዚያ ስለ ክፉ ሰዎች ስድብ ይጮኻሉ፥
እግዚአብሔር በእውነት ክፉ ነገርን ሊያይ አይወድም።
ክፉ የሚሠሩትን አይሰማቸውም፥ እኔንም ያድነኛል፤
አሁን ቍጣውን የሚያውቅ የለምና፥
ኢዮብ ግን አፉን በከንቱ ይከፍታል፥
And Elihu answered and said:
"Yet there is a matter which I would speak, and I pray you to listen to me a little,
I will bring forth my knowledge from afar,
My words shall be without falsehood; they are a true utterance.
"The Lord God, who is mighty in wisdom and strength,
He does not preserve the life of the wicked;
His eyes do not turn away from the righteous;
He binds their hands in chains,
He will declare their works and their transgressions,
But the righteous He will hear."
ቢሰሙና ቢያገለግሉትም፥
ኃጥኣንን ግን አያድናቸውም
“ግብዞች ግን በልባቸው ቍጣን ያዘጋጃሉ፤
ስለዚህም በሕፃንነታቸው ሳሉ ሰውነታቸው ትጠፋለች፥
የተቸገረውንና ረዳት የሌለውን አስጨንቀዋልና፥
አንተን ግን ከጠላትህ አፍ አድኖሃል፥
ፍርድን ለጻድቃን አያዘገይምና።
ይበድሉ ዘንድ በተቀበሉት መማለጃ ኀጢአት ምክንያት
በጭንቀት ካሉ ከችግረኞች ልመና የተነሣ
በእነርሱ ፋንታ ወገኖች እንዲገቡ፥
Do good, and do not be weary.
"Behold, the mighty Lord shall prevail in His strength."
Who is it that can discern His work?
Though men strive to accomplish,
every man is his own.
Behold, the mighty Lord is great, and we do not know Him;
the stars of His glory are counted by Him.
The ancient shall be exalted.
A man shall gather the clouds of heaven,
behold, He shall illuminate His surroundings with light.
He shall judge among these nations;
He shall cause light to shine forth from His hand,
Concerning Him and His beloved,
"Therefore my heart has rejoiced in me,
Hearken to the voice of the Lord God of hosts,
He who is above all the heavens,
In the sound of His voice, He shall cry out;
The mighty Lord shall perform wonders with His voice;
The snow and the hail, and the strong rain,
Let every man know his own weakness;
The wild beasts shall enter into the thicket;
The dwelling place that is forsaken is in trouble;
From the mighty Lord, when He breathes forth, the tempest shall come forth."
የተመረጡትን በደመና ይሰውራል፤
እርሱም ሰው በሚኖርበት ዓለም ላይ፥
ይኸውም፥ ለተግሣጽ
“ኢዮብ ሆይ፥ ይህን ስማ፤
እግዚአብሔር ሥራውን እንዳከናወነ
የደመናትን ክፍሎች፥
የአዜብ ነፋስ በተኮሰ ጊዜ ያንተ ልብስህ የሞቀ ነው።
እንደ ቀለጠ መስተዋት
ስለዚህ ንገረኝ! ምን እንለዋለን?
“ሰው በእኔ ዘንድ ሲቆም ዝም እል ዘንድ፥
"The light that is seen by all is not so."
"From the north, a cloud shall arise that shines like gold;"
"In strength, it shall be equal with Him,"
"Therefore, men shall fear Him;"

sections.title: The Lord answered Job as he had spoken.

verses.text: And after Elihu had spoken, the Lord answered Job out of the whirlwind and the storm, saying:
"He who would contend with Me, let him show himself."
"Now, prepare yourself like a man; I will question you, and you shall answer Me."
"Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Tell Me, if you have understanding."
"Who determined its measurements? Surely you know!"
"Or who stretched the line upon it?"
"To what were its foundations fastened? Or who laid its cornerstone?"
"When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?"
"I adorned it with clouds and wrapped it in thick darkness."
"I set limits for it and placed bars and doors."
እስከዚህ ድረስ ድረሺ፥ ከወሰንሽም አትለፊ፤
“የንጋት ወገግታ በአንተ ተፈጥሮአልን?
የምድርን ዳርቻ ይይዝ ዘንድ፥
አንተ ጭቃውን ከመሬት ወስደህ
የኃጥኣንን ብርሃናቸውን ከልክለሃልን?
ወደ ባሕር ምንጭስ ውስጥ ገብተሃልን?
ከግርማህስ የተነሣ የሞት በሮች ተከፍተውልሃልን?
ከሰማይ በታች ያለ የምድርንስ ስፋት አስተውለሃልን?
“የብርሃን ማደርያው ቦታ የት ነው?
ትችል እንደ ሆነ፥
At that time, you were born,
Truly, have you entered the house of the snow?
This is during your enemy's time.
From where does the storm arise?
For the mighty one, the source of the rain,
No one dwells upon the earth without Him,
To bind the tempest and the storm,
Who is the father of the rain?
From whom does the snow come forth?
He also descends like a flowing water.
"Truly, you shall bind the seven stars to your command,
Or you shall cause the constellations, known as the Mazaroth, to arise in their season,
The order of the heavens,
Do you call forth the cloud by your word?
Do you send forth the lightning? Does it go at your bidding?
For women, the wisdom of the net,
Who is able to bind the heavenly cloud with wisdom?
As a tent, it is spread upon the earth;
"Will you hunt the lioness for your prey?
They are slain within their dens."
ልጆቹ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሲጮኹ፥
"Do you know the time when you shall give birth?"
"Is it not true that you shall count the full months of her pregnancy?"
"Shall you not protect her children without fear?"
"Her children shall be cherished."
"Who has brought forth the freedom of the wilderness?"
"To him belongs the house of the desert,"
"And the people of the city shall be gathered together;"
"The mountain shall be regarded as a refuge,"
"Shall he serve you in order that he may be accepted?"
"Shall you not be troubled in the day of your distress?"
Is it because of thy strength that thou dost trust in her?
She shall return unto thee as thou hast sown,
"She shall rejoice with gladness in her heart,
and upon the earth she shall tread with joy,
that her feet may be established,
and she shall not be as those who are without children;
for the Lord hath granted her wisdom beyond her own,
in her time she shall lift up her head on high,
"Hast thou given her the armor for the horse?
Hast thou provided her with the complete weapons of war?
በኮቴው በሸለቆው ውስጥ ይጐደፍራል፥
በሚገናኘው ፍላጻ ላይ ይስቃል።
ቀስትና ጦር በእርሱ ላይ ይበረታሉ፥
በቍጣውም መሬትን ያጠፋል፤
የመለከትም ድምፅ ሲሰማ፦ እሰይ ይላል፤
“በውኑ ከጥበብህ የተነሣ ጭልፊት ያንዣብባልን?
በአፍህ ትእዛዝ ንስር ከፍ ከፍ ይላልን?
በዓለቱ ገደል ላይ ይኖራል፤
በዚያም ሆኖ የሚበላውን ይፈልጋል፤
ጫጭቶቹም ወደ ደም ይሮጣሉ፥
And the Lord answered, and said unto Job,
"Truly, the one who is contending."
And Job answered, and said unto the Lord,
"If Thou dost instruct me, what shall I answer Thee?
Once have I spoken,

sections.title: The Lord answered Job as he had spoken.

verses.text: እግዚአብሔርም እንደገና በደመና ውስጥ ሆኖ ለኢዮብ መለሰለት፥ እንዲህም አለ፦
“እንግዲህ እንደ ወንድ ወገብህን ታጠቅ፤
ወይም ፍርዴን መቃወምህን ተው፥
እንደ እግዚአብሔር ክንድ ያለ ክንድ አለህን?
እስኪ ልዕልናንና ኀይልን ተላበስ፤
የቍጣህን መላእክት ላክ፤
ትዕቢተኛውን ሰው ዝቅ ዝቅ አድርገው፤
በአፈር ውስጥ በአንድነት ሰውራቸው፤
በዚያን ጊዜ ቀኝ እጅህ ታድንህ ዘንድ እንድትችል፥
“እነሆ፥ በአንተ ዘንድ የዱር አውሬ አለ፤
Behold, His strength is within His people;
He has made them like a cedar tree, strong and mighty;
The bone of the weak is as a reed;
This is the creation of the Lord, marvelous in its works.
And when he ascends to the high mountain,
beneath the tree that is in the valley,
the tree that bears fruit shall flourish in its abundance;
Behold, though the river may swell, it shall not overflow;
Shall the eye, having seen, hold us in its gaze?
"Indeed, shall you be cast out by the one who is strong?"
ወይስ ስናጋ በጕንጩ ታደርጋለህን?
በውኑ ወደ አንተ እጅግ ይለምናልን?
በውኑ ከአንተ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ይገባልን?
ከዎፍ ጋር እንደምትጫወት ከእርሱ ጋር ትጫወታለህን?
አሕዛብ ይመገቡታልን?
ጀልባዎች ሁሉ ቢሰበሰቡ የጅራቱን ቍርበት ሊሸከሙት አይችሉም።
እጅህን በላዩ ጫን፤
Fear not, for I have prepared you.
Who is he that shall contend with me, and who shall live?
Concerning Him, I shall not be silent.
Who can declare the hiding place of His face?
Who is he that can uncover His ears?
The creatures are as the beasts of the field;
For they are bound to one another,
A man shall be as one with his brother;
His brightness shall bring forth light,
From His mouth shall come forth the light of understanding.
As fire consumes the dry grass,
Its breath is like a flame.
With strength it shall prevail upon its back;
The flesh of the body is as if it were torn asunder;
The heart is like a stone that trembles;
In the time of return, the beast and the creature shall be afraid,
Even if they obtain sword and armor, and escape and refuge,
In Him, the refuge and the armor of iron are as a garment.
The escape of the wicked cannot be achieved;
The crow shall be as a shadow.
መኝታው እንደ ስለታም ድንጋይ ነው፤
ቀላይዋን እንደ ብረት ድስት ያፈላታል፤
የሲኦልም ጥልቀት እንደ ምርኮ ነው።
በተፈጠረ ጊዜ መላእክቴ የሣቁበት፥
ከፍ ያለውን ሁሉ ይመለከታል፤
And Job answered, and said unto the Lord,
"I know that Thou canst do all things, and that no purpose of Thine can be thwarted.
Who is this that hides counsel without knowledge? Therefore have I uttered that which I understood not, things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
"O Lord, I beseech Thee, hear me; I will speak, and I will ask of Thee, and do Thou instruct me.
I had heard of Thee by the hearing of the ear; but now mine eye seeth Thee.
Wherefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes. I know that I am but dust and ashes."

sections.title: The friends of Job, as they were gathered.

verses.text: And the Lord spoke these words to Eliphaz the Temanite, saying, "You have not spoken of Me what is right, as My servant Job has. Therefore, you and your two friends shall bear the consequences of your folly."

"Now therefore, take for yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to My servant Job, and offer up a burnt offering for yourselves. And My servant Job shall pray for you; for I will accept him, lest I deal with you according to your folly, because you have not spoken of Me what is right, as My servant Job has."
So Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite went and did as the Lord commanded them; and the Lord accepted Job's prayer, and did not grant them forgiveness for their sins.

sections.title: The health and wealth of Job were restored.

verses.text: And the Lord restored Job. And Job prayed for his friends, and the Lord accepted their sin; and the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before.

And his brothers and sisters, all who had known him before, came to him, and they ate bread with him in his house, and they comforted him; and the Lord turned away all the evil that had come upon him; and each one gave him a piece of money, and a ring of gold.
And the Lord blessed the latter days of Job more than his beginning; for he had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.
And there were born to him seven sons and three daughters.
And he called the name of the first Jemimah, and the name of the second Keziah, and the name of the third Keren-happuch.
And in all the land were no women found so fair as the daughters of Job; and their father gave them inheritance among their brothers.
And Job lived a hundred and forty years after this, and saw his children and his children's children to the fourth generation.
So Job died, being old and full of days.
The Lord is written as one who rises again with those who are raised.
This man is described in the book of Syria as such. And the land where he lived is without a city in Edom and in the Arabian region.
And his name was formerly Jobab, and he took a woman of the Arabians. And she bore him a son, whose name was Enon. He was the son of Esau, the son of Zarah. And his mother was called Basemath.
He was the fifth from Abraham. And he was among the kings who reigned in his own land in Edom.
Formerly, he was called the son of Beor, who was Balak. And the name of his city was Dinhabah.
After Balak, his name was called Job, and he was known as Jobab. And after him, there was a king who reigned in the land of Teman, named Asshon.
After him, in the land of Moab, there was a man named Adad, who killed the Midianites. And the name of the city was Getham.
And those who came to him, and among them was one of the sons of Esau, born in Teman, named Eliphaz, and those who dwelt in Auwkin, and the king of the Ammonites, named Sofer.
